ex.s: Not long ago, my fifth-grade son Kevin asked me about the meaning of a word in a novel.
ex.t: 不久前，我上五年级的儿子凯文问我一本小说里一个词的意思。

ex.s: Suddenly it occurred to me that he did not even know how to use a dictionary.
ex.t: 我突然意识到，他甚至不知道怎么用词典。

ex.s: While going through the pages, he kept saying, wide-eyed: “How can there be this many words?” After a while, he looked at me and asked, “Do you know all these words, Mom?” I smiled, “I definitely do not know all these words,” I said.
ex.t: 他翻着书页，睁大眼睛不停地说：“怎么会有这么多词？”过了一会儿，他看着我问：“妈妈，你认识所有这些词吗？”我笑着说：“我确实不认识所有这些词。”

ex.s: And it wasn't, ultimately, the dictionary that got me there — not really.
ex.t: 说到底，真正让我走到今天的并不是那本词典——并不是。

ex.t: 她问我哪一首与诗歌最匹配。

ex.s: Awake from a short sleep in her chair, my grandmother ran her fingers through her wavy white hair, looked out her window at the blue sky, and asked me what I would wish for if I had just one wish.
ex.t: 祖母从椅子上的短暂小睡中醒来，手指捋过波浪般的白发，望向窗外蓝天，问我如果只有一个愿望，我会许什么愿。

ex.s: I entered the room and the teachers made me say some lines from the musical.
ex.t: 我走进房间，老师们让我念了音乐剧里的几句台词。

ex.s: One night, in my early 40s, I dreamed that a big woman in red approached me, handed me a bag of paints, and told me to start painting.
ex.t: 在我40岁出头的一个夜晚，我梦见一个穿红衣的高大女人走近我，递给我一袋颜料，让我开始画画。

ex.s: The dream felt so authoritative that it shook me.
ex.t: 这个梦感觉如此权威，震撼了我。

ex.s: It was a form of energy, giving me back something I’d lost.
ex.t: 那是一种能量，让我找回了失去的东西。

ex.s: That dream reminded me that those fears and desires could encourage me to take risks and make experiments.
ex.t: 那个梦提醒我，那些恐惧和欲望可以鼓励我去冒险和尝试。

ex.s: As I began designing experiments, my committee members warned me about the challenges I would face.
ex.t: 当我开始设计实验时，我的委员会成员警告过我将会面临的挑战。

ex.s: But my need for independence drove me to push forward with my research plan.
ex.t: 但我对独立的需求驱使我继续推进我的研究计划。

ex.s: It was full of ideas that were new to me so I spent the summer with my head in and out of that book.

ex.s: I used to afraid of insects, but last Friday’s biology class make a big change in me.
ex.t: 我过去害怕昆虫，但上周五的生物课让我发生了很大的改变。

ex.s: In the evening, when I take the walk in the school garden, the singing of insects become more meaningful to me.
ex.t: 晚上，当我在学校花园里散步时，昆虫的鸣叫对我来说变得更有意义了。

ex.s: I experienced this when I started switching to a zero waste lifestyle five years ago, as I was living with my parents, and I continue to experience this with my husband, as he is not completely zero waste like me.
ex.t: 五年前我刚开始转向零废弃生活方式时就有这种体会，那时我和父母同住；现在和丈夫在一起也继续有这种体会，因为他不像我那样完全零废弃。

ex.s: A few days later, I came back with my first jars of zero waste groceries, and my dad commented on how silly it was for me to carry jars everywhere.
ex.t: 几天后，我带着第一批零浪费杂货罐回来，我爸爸评论说，我到处带着罐子真是傻。

ex.s: When I opened my hand, the bird did not fly away; she sat looking at me with her bright eyes.
ex.t: 当我张开手时，这只鸟没有飞走；她坐着用明亮的眼睛看着我。

ex.s: That said, with a bang of the starting gun, I would dive into the cold water with all my strength and swim to the other side of the pool as fast as I could, only to find that the other swimmers slid past me.
ex.t: 话虽如此，随着发令枪响，我会全力扎进冷水中，尽可能快地游向泳池另一边，却发现其他游泳者从我身边滑过。

ex.s: I would have given it up if I had not heard my father's encouraging shouts to cheer me on.
ex.t: 要不是听到父亲那鼓励我、为我加油的喊声，我早就放弃了。

ex.s: When at last my hand would grab the edge of the pool, he would always be there with a warm, dry towel, telling me how proud he was of my desperate efforts.
ex.t: 当我终于用手抓住池边时，他总会拿着一条温暖干燥的毛巾在那里，告诉我他为我拼尽全力的努力感到多么骄傲。

ex.s: So I was shocked when, not long after the email, Professor Mary Devon, who was running the programme, invited me to observe the work being done in her lab.

ex.s: I jumped at the chance, and a few weeks later I was equally shocked—and overjoyed—when she invited me to talk with her about potential projects I could pursue in her lab.
ex.t: 我毫不犹豫地抓住了这个机会，几周后，当她邀请我与她讨论我可以在她的实验室里开展的潜在项目时，我同样震惊——而且欣喜若狂。

ex.s: Thirty years later， a woman approached me in a public place． "Excuse me， did you ever enter a residence， long ago， thinking it was the McNay Museum？"

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 但我内心深处有一种无论如何都要攀登那座山的冲动。我迫不及待地想要再次尝试这次冒险。

ex.s: But something inside me was going to climb that mountain at all cost． I could hardly wait to try this adventure again．
ex.t: 但我内心有股力量要不惜一切代价去爬那座山。我迫不及待地想再试一次这次冒险。

ex.s: In fact, in an interview, an important question to ask is: “ What would be expected of me as an employee?” In today's tough 'job market, young job seekers need to provide a potential employer with good reasons to hire them.
